svg.text: OpenPatch v0.1.0 cup pod OP-100: top view, 48.0 x 36.6 x 8.5 mm (lane 1 bottom, lane 2 top; motor at the rear/left)
to scale; TEST ONLY, water only, never worn. Plunger at FULL. Keep-out boxes = reserved volumes (no PCB). Dock/head dimensions TODO-MEASURE (photo estimate). Dashed circle = head before the slide.
1 Motor NFP-608-26.45 TRANSVERSE (axis Y), last element at the rear, spans both lanes
2 Gear A: miter bevel m0.3 z12 on the motor shaft (2 mm bore, faced)
3 Gear B: miter bevel m0.3 z12 tapped onto the rod (only 2 gears)
4 Rod M1.6 x 0.35 ends flush with gear B, rotating, axially fixed (18.1 mm)
5 Plunger cup 20.3 x 5.7, 14.4 mm long, blind bore (drawn at FULL)
6 Brass nut M1.6 in the hex pocket (rear of the cup)
7 Single lip seal (S2) at the closed front end
8 Tank 20.5 x 5.9 bore (132 U), closed walls, NO slot, open dry rim
9 Outlet through the front wall straight into the needle hub (+X)
10 30G needle (+X) with spring guard
11 Fill septum, UNDERSIDE of the front wall
12 Dock U-slot 9.8 wide, open below + at the end, insertion 3.5 mm
13 Two L-springs 301 FH 0.05, teeth in the dome notches
14 Dock magnet in the head + dock hall above the pocket roof
15 Diametric magnet on gear B's rear face
16 TMAG5273 beside the magnet (0.5 mm gap), tiny sensor tab
17 Cell Ampul 301030 x 8.9-40.4, leads WEST (VERIFY on sample)
18 USB-C mid-mount in a board notch, STADIUM opening x 19.0-28.0 in the +Y wall, z 4.00-7.40
19 Main board x 7.8-43.4 z 5.3-6.1 (+ top parts to 7.55)
20 Antenna clearance east of the board (no parts)
21 Rear corner of lane 1: empty, not tank-convertible (accepted void)
22 Beside the pocket: empty except the hidden vent (d0.8 + ePTFE disc)
23 Board-leg keep-out: sounder + dock hall under the board (reserved space)
24 Collar + PTFE shim + bush + printed rib (thrust bearing)
25 Wire channel x 7.0-8.9: motor 4 + cell 2 (soldered) + TMAG strip
26 Board ledges d1.0 top z 5.3 + lid ribs above (part-free pads d1.6)
27 West wall shelf z 5.3 + lid rib above (part-free pad)
28 Board screw W: M1.2x4 brass into boss d1.8 (board tab x 7.33-9.53)
29 Board screw E: M1.2x4 brass into boss d1.8 (side_b leg)
30 Side button: printed cap d1.6 + O-ring 1.5 x 0.5 in the lid wall, pad on SW1, stroke 0.3
